info.name: Impala Hotel Booking Bookings Rate Calendar API
List all rate plans (rate calendar) for a hotel (Beta endpoint)

params.name: hotelId
params.description: The uuid of hotel for which rate plans are being fetched.

params.name: updatedAt
params.description: Returns rate plans changed after the supplied date.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of rate plans returned on a given page (pagination).

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset from the first rate plan in the result (for pagination).

params.name: start
params.description: Start date of the considered time window for the returned rate plan.

params.name: end
params.description: Start date of the considered time window for the returned rate plan.

params.name: roomId
params.description: The UUID of room for which rate plans are being fetched.

items.docs:
Returns a list of all rate plans available for you for a hotel.

Rate plans are products the hotel is offering. They typically consist of a combination of restrictiveness in case of cancellations or changes, the time they're bookable, minimum or maximum length of stay restrictions (e.g. week-long bookings), included components like breakfast or dinner and/or the conditions under which the room can be sold (e.g. private rates that can only be offered and sold to a closed user group behind login).
